selection.boundaryRule: Interior includes points on the chosen outer/hole boundaries, excludes strict hole interiors. Context means outside the combined boundaries but referenced by a selected complete way.
selection.dateSemantics: timestamp is the original OSM edit time. Retrieval times describe saved responses, not field observations or capture. Unknown retrieval times remain null; observedAt and capturedAt are null.
selection.ordering: records ascending numeric OSM node ID; object keys and all string lists lexicographic; numeric memberships ascending; UTF-8 JSON with two-space indentation and one final LF.
selection.scope: University campus baseline; complete-way context preserved separately.
selection.studyAreaRule: studyAreaIds are joins through selected ways, not point coordinates or official neighborhoods. unlinkedAuditStudyAreaId preserves the prior audit coordinate grouping for raw-only nodes; it is not a path/section connection.
selection.tagPolicy: All original tags on these 333 records are preserved exactly, including fixme and public transit operator/name fields. No editor/contact/personal metadata tags occur in this reviewed set.
